exposure: Recurrent spontaneous spinal epidural hematoma (SSEH) during pregnancy
cohort: A 27-year-old primigravida at 37 weeks' gestation with a history of fenestration for a spontaneous cervical hematoma when she was 18 years old.
finding: A rare case of recurrent spontaneous spinal epidural hematoma during pregnancy with no neurologic deficits showed spontaneous resolution with nonoperative management.
